headline: NORWAY 🇳🇴 MOURNS 👑 King Harald as Haakon VIII 🍆 ASCENDS 🪑 Throne
text:
NORWAY 🇳🇴 is straight up WEEPING 😢 after their beloved KING 👑 Harald V finally CROSSED 🪦 over at 89 years old following treatment for a rare BLOOD 🩸 condition that had the palace STAFF 🧑‍⚖️ on EDGE 🫣 for weeks!! His son now KING 🏰 Haakon VIII just dropped the most HEARTFELT 💔 speech from a desk in the ROYAL 🏛️ palace right beside a framed pic of his late DAD 👴 two LIT 🕯️ candles and a bowl of pure white ROSES 🌹 while choking back TEARS 🥲 the whole time!! "Thank you for being such a good DAD 👨‍👧‍👦" he said in an at times emotional TELEVISED 📺 address that had the entire nation clutching their CHESTS 🫀!! Now it is MY 🫵 turn he declared adding a MAJOR 🏋️ task awaits and he wishes to stay PRESENT 🎁 and ATTENTIVE 👀 going forward while stressing NATIONAL 🇳🇴 UNITY 🤝 in a society built on LAW ⚖️ and JUSTICE 🗡️ where everyone holds EQUAL ⚖️ value!!

KING 👑 Haakon VIII made sure to paint his late father Harald as the ultimate FAMILY 👨‍👧‍👦 man who was a good DAD 👔 to him and sister Princess Märtha Louise plus a WARM 🔥 and FUNNY 😂 grandfather to his six GRANDKIDS 🧒 and a LOVING ❤️ and CARING 🤲 husband to widow Queen Sonja whose 58th wedding ANNIVERSARY 💍 would have hit on Saturday!! The new king appeared to SWALLOW 😣 a golfball sized lump in his throat recalling how Harald brought the family together with NATURAL 🌲 authority he might not have even known he possessed and had always STAYED 🛡️ true to his values and commitments reminding everyone to do things in their OWN 🧩 way find their own STYLE 💃 and just BE 🧘 themselves bro!! He called the sight of thousands of NORWEGIANS 🇳🇴 gathering outside the Oslo palace with FLOWERS 🌺 tributes and CANDLES 🕯️ a powerful and MOVING 🚚 experience that brings COMFORT 🛏️ and STRENGTH 💪 even while the whole country sits in MOURNING 🖤!!

Oslo MAYOR 🏙️ already called off a whole WEDDING 💒 ceremony because the death hit so HARD 🪨 and Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre showed up to lay FLOWERS 🌷 sign the condolence BOOK 📖 and tell reporters the country is UNITED 🤝 in grief and GRATITUDE 🙌 after greeting the fresh KING 👑!! A national PERIOD 📅 of mourning has been declared with no funeral DATE 📆 set yet while Norwegians keep piling TRIBUTES 🎁 and memories at the palace gates like it's the only way to process the LOSS 💔!! Haakon will swear his OATH 📜 of allegiance in parliament on Tuesday then do a stripped down CONSECRATION 🙏 service with wife Queen Mette Marit because Norway ditched full coronations ages ago like a chill UNC 🧊 who keeps it simple!!

The fresh KING 👑 steps into this role at a super DIFFICULT 😣 time after the royal family got absolutely COOKED 🍳 by health scares and SCANDALS 😬 this year that left everyone side eyeing the MONARCHY 👑 poll numbers which just TANKED 📉 from 72 percent last year all the way down to 54 percent according to Aftenposten!! Queen Mette Marit caught HEAT 🔥 for her three year friendship with the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and had to publicly APOLOGIZE 🙇 before later getting a LUNG 🫁 transplant after battling pulmonary fibrosis since 2018 with docs saying she won't be declared STABLE 🪨 until next year forcing Haakon to juggle new official DUTIES 📋 with her CARE 🩹!!

Her son from a previous relationship Marius Borg Høiby who was raised inside the royal bubble since age four got CONVICTED ⚖️ in June of rape and other OFFENCES 🚔 earning a four year prison sentence that he is currently APPEALING 🏛️ which obviously didn't help the FAMILY 👪 optics one bit!! Haakon's sister Märtha Louise also stirred the POT 🥘 by remarrying an American self styled SHAMAN 🧙 in 2024 with their business moves eventually forcing her to step back from royal DUTIES 🛠️ leaving the new king to navigate some serious TURBULENCE 🌊 without directly naming any of it in his speech!! Instead he said the family has learned the importance of STANDING 🧍‍♂️ together to remain STEADFAST 🪨 both within themselves and for one another during difficult times while promising he Mette Marit and Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra will always strive to understand different people's LIFE 🧬 situations and stand by one another through GOOD ☀️ days and difficult ONES 🔄!! Norwegian royal experts told the BBC that despite the family DRAMA 🎭 the new king is respected hard working and built different enough to move the monarchy FORWARD 🏃‍♂️ even with all these CHALLENGES 🧗!!
